name: get-tos-lambda
description: Retrieves Terms of Service (TOS) clause details for specific clause types including Refund, Delivery, and Payment policies

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for retrieving TOS clause information

clause_type.description: The type of Terms of Service clause to retrieve. Must be one of: Refund, Delivery, or Payment

outputSchema.description: Response containing the requested TOS clause details

clause_details.description: The detailed text content of the requested Terms of Service clause
